title: Writing Formal Submissions to Public Bodies
grammar: Institutional formulaic case government in formal petitions (hivatkozással valamire, eleget téve)
goal: I can say what a formal submission to an authority contains.
I can use fixed letter openings such as hivatkozással a törvényre and eleget téve a felszólításnak.
I can structure a statement of facts (tényállás), legal grounds and attachments, and ask politely with kérem, hogy.
